originalReview.notes: Exact2048x1536native inspected: church and bell dome, south portal, west entry and adjacent long dormitory facade/turret. Photograph crops the far western and eastern ends; those mapped repetitions remain approximate.

Exact3888x2592native inspected: two broad courtyard sides and chamfered corner, three-shaft lower bays, paired upper lights, open gallery depth, medallion/parapet bands, conical pinnacles and clay roof edge. Fine sculpted carving remains generalized.
